adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the diff changes category assignment from a global setting (`SiteSetting.embed_category`) to a per-host lookup: `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` and `category: eh.try(:category_id)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). If no `EmbeddableHost` matches the URL, `eh` is nil and the category passed to `PostCreator` becomes nil. The diff does not add an explicit fallback or error in that case, so the review concern about an uncovered edge-case (what happens when no host matches) is grounded. However, the claim that topics will “silently land in uncategorized” is not directly verifiable from this diff (depends on `PostCreator` behavior and call sites), so it’s best treated as a non-bug review issue about missing handling/clarity.
